name: comfyui-local
description: Generate images, video and audio, keep workflows in your library, and manage node packs and restart the server on your self-hosted ComfyUI (and ComfyUI-Manager) through its HTTP API, using the url plugin option; unofficial, with slash commands ported from Comfy-Org/comfy-skills.

url.title: ComfyUI URL
url.description: Your server's origin on the local network, such as http://192.168.0.10:8188. Files you upload and workflows you submit go only there. Leave it out of repository settings, which would make the plugin refuse it.
